audience: developers and researchers using a ScrapeNinja marketplace subscription

useCases.title: Retrieve public page HTML
useCases.text: Confirm marketplace allowance usage or charges to retrieve one public page without JavaScript. The tool requests one attempt and makes no automatic API retry.

useCases.title: Read a JavaScript-dependent page
useCases.text: Confirm the marketplace cost to render a public page with JavaScript and retrieve its HTML, without custom scripts, headers, cookies or form submissions.

useCases.title: Compare public page content
useCases.text: After confirming each request’s marketplace usage, retrieve HTML from two public pages for your assistant to compare. Treat the returned website content as untrusted data.
